actions.heading: Obtain the Divisional Secretary’s countersignature
actions.essential: Non-estate route: obtain the countersignature after certification.
conditions: The applicant is not an estate resident and seeks an NIC amendment.

source_context.text: The non-estate route also requires the Divisional Secretary's countersignature on the application certified through the Grama Niladhari.

For an estate resident, forward the amendment application through the Estate Superintendent. The amended-card issue fee is LKR 500 and can be paid through the certifying officer. Normal registered-post delivery adds LKR 120; that postal charge is outside the recorded base fee.

For a non-estate resident, forward the amendment application through the Grama Niladhari for the area of residence. The amended-card issue fee is LKR 500 and can be paid through the certifying officer. Normal registered-post delivery adds LKR 120; that postal charge is outside the recorded base fee.

actions.explanation_visible: This is another step in the same route, not an alternative to Grama Niladhari certification. No separate countersignature fee is specified in this snapshot; that does not establish that it is free.
actions.source_wording:
